snippet.title: SUPER AC - SKY LEGENDS, An Aeropostal Epic, Trailer Jean Mermoz 4k
snippet.description:
Discover the famous Jean Mermoz, first pilote to cross Atlantic ocean by plane in 1930, in SKY LEGENDS, an epic VR adventure game coming May 18!

SKY LEGENDS, An Aeropostal Epic, now wishlist on Meta Quest Store :
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/sky-legends/24139562482340113/

Also available on Steam wishlist :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846630/SKY_LEGENDS__An_Aeropostal_Epic/
